svg.title: siRNA Duplex
svg.desc: Generic short antiparallel siRNA duplex with connected paired bases and two illustrative unpaired nucleotide marks on each opposite 3-prime extension. No sequence, exact duplex length, guide-strand assignment or silencing outcome is specified.
